lessons.title: 15.1 Homeostatic control
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain homeostatic control and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

Homeostasis maintains internal conditions within workable limits through receptors, a control centre and effectors, commonly using negative feedback.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

explanations.sd: هوميوسٽيسس ريسپٽرن، ڪنٽرول سينٽر ۽ اثر ڪندڙ عضون وسيلي اندروني حالتون مناسب حد ۾ رکي ٿو، عام طور منفي فيڊ بيڪ سان.

lessons.title: 15.2 Osmoregulation
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain osmoregulation and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

Osmoregulation balances water and solutes; freshwater, marine and terrestrial animals face different osmotic challenges and use different adaptations.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

explanations.ur: اوسمو ریگولیشن پانی اور حل شدہ مادوں کا توازن رکھتی ہے؛ میٹھے پانی، سمندر اور خشکی کے جانوروں کو مختلف مسائل درپیش ہوتے ہیں۔

lessons.title: 15.3 Excretion
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain excretion and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

Excretion removes metabolic wastes such as ammonia, urea and uric acid; the dominant product often reflects habitat and water availability.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

lessons.title: 15.4 Human urinary system
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain human urinary system and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

Kidneys contain nephrons; filtration, selective reabsorption, secretion and counter-current processes help form and concentrate urine.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

explanations.ur: گردوں میں نیفرون ہوتے ہیں؛ فلٹریشن، منتخب دوبارہ جذب، اخراج اور کاؤنٹر کرنٹ عمل پیشاب بناتے اور گاڑھا کرتے ہیں۔

lessons.title: 15.5 Thermoregulation and disorders
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain thermoregulation and disorders and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

Humans regulate temperature through sweating, blood-vessel responses and behavioural changes; urinary disorders include infection, stones and renal failure.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

explanations.ur: انسان پسینے، خون کی نالیوں کے ردعمل اور رویے کی تبدیلی سے درجہ حرارت منظم کرتا ہے؛ پیشاب کی نالی کے مسائل میں انفیکشن، پتھری اور گردوں کی ناکامی شامل ہیں۔
